name: Grand Palace
_about: THE GRAND PALACE, BANGKOK (from 1782) and WAT PHRA KAEW: the white crenellated palace wall with its forts and spired gates; the temple's cloister of the Ramakien murals with its gates and twelve yakshas; the ubosot of the Emerald Buddha on its marble terrace, the twelve salas and the bell tower; the upper terrace with the gilt Phra Si Rattana Chedi, the Phra Mondop, the Prasat Phra Thep Bidon and the model of Angkor Wat; the eight prangs; the Middle Court's throne halls -- the Phra Maha Monthien (Amarin Winitchai, Phaisan Thaksin, Chakraphat Phiman), the Chakri Maha Prasat (a European body under three spired Thai roofs), the Dusit Maha Prasat and the Aphorn Phimok; the Boromphiman; the Outer Court's offices and lawns. Plan from OpenStreetMap and the Commons plans, the Inner Court not built (tools/archgen/grand_palace.py).
